title: Month-to-Month Rent Increases and Required Notice by Community — Home-Site Lease
content:
Mid-term rent increases under the Home-Site Lease apply only to a month-to-month lease; a fixed-term lease changes rent only when a new term begins under the renewal terms.

**Required notice days by community**

| Community | Required notice days |
|---|---|
| Willow Bend Estates | 90 |
| Palmetto Shores | 90 |
| Saguaro Vista | 90 |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | 60 |
| Cedar Hollow | 60 |
| Conestoga Meadows | 60 |

The community is the community in which the leased site lies, as the lease record shows.

**Terms of a rent-increase notice**

- A rent-increase notice states the new rent and an effective date that is the first day of a billing period.
- A noticed rent increase may take effect no earlier than the community's required notice days counted from the rent-increase notice date. The notice period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice date, and the increase may apply from the first billing period that begins on or after the last day of that period.
- One notice may raise the rent by at most the lot class's month-to-month increase cap, as a percentage of the monthly site rent on the notice date, the highest new rent being rounded half up to the cent.
- No more than the lot class's limit of rent increases may take effect in the 12 months ending on the effective date. Counted in that window are the rent-increase notices on the lease whose effective date falls in it, plus one when the current term began in it at a higher rent under a renewal offer or holdover. A notice that would exceed the limit is void and the rent stays unchanged.
- A notice that gives fewer days than required does not take effect on its stated date; it takes effect on the first billing period that begins on or after the end of the full notice period.

**Worked dates (hypothetical notices)**

| Community | Notice date | Last day of the notice period | Earliest effective date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluebonnet Ridge (60 days) | 10 March 2026 | 9 May 2026 | 1 June 2026 |
| Willow Bend Estates (90 days) | 3 March 2026 | 1 June 2026 | 1 June 2026 |

The second row shows the boundary: when the last day of the notice period is itself the first day of a billing period, the increase may apply from that day. A Bluebonnet Ridge notice dated 10 March 2026 that states an effective date of 1 May 2026 gives fewer days than required and takes effect on 1 June 2026.

**Cap (hypothetical)** — on a monthly site rent of 700.00 and a cap of 6.5 percent, the highest new rent one notice may state is 745.50.
